fact: The health ministry's statistical yearbook for 2023, compiled by its DSNIS from public, faith-based, associative and private facilities through the national DHIS2 platform, states that a DSNIS IT cell administers DHIS2, that monthly reports are keyed into DHIS2 by the tenth of the following month with community reports passed to the health centre for entry, and that across 1,159 health centres in 2023 the national average was 95.5% for report completeness and 84.8% for timeliness of data entry.
title: Annuaire des Statistiques Sanitaires 2023
publisher: Ministère de la Santé Publique et de la Lutte contre le SIDA, Direction du Système National d'Information Sanitaire
